definitions.explanation: Lines printed or drawn on paper to guide writing, or lines used in tables and spreadsheets. Refers to both horizontal and vertical ruling lines.

examples.japanese: {罫線|けいせん}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{沿|そ}って→沿う：13279_sou⟧⟦{書|か}く→書く：00477_kaku⟧。
⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{用紙|ようし}→用紙：09588_youshi⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{罫線|けいせん}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{引|ひ}いてある→引く：01978_hiku⟧。
examples.english: This paper has ruled lines on it.

examples.japanese: エクセル⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{表|ひょう}→表：19354_hyou⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{罫線|けいせん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{追加|ついか}して→追加する：19646_tsuikasuru⟧⟦{見|み}→見る：00283_miru⟧やすく⟦した→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: I added grid lines to the Excel table to make it easier to read.

notes:
USAGE:
Used for both physical ruled lines on paper and digital grid lines in spreadsheets and documents. In office and computing contexts, adding or removing {罫線|けいせん} is a common formatting task.

FORMS:
{罫|けい} (ruled line, square) + ⟦{線|せん}→線：09901_sen⟧ (line).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {罫線|けいせん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{引|ひ}く→引く：01978_hiku⟧: draw ruled lines
- {罫線|けいせん}{入|い}り: with ruled lines, lined
- {罫線|けいせん}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{沿|そ}って→沿う：13279_sou⟧: along the ruled lines
- {罫線|けいせん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{追加|ついか}する→追加する：19646_tsuikasuru⟧: add grid lines
